metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter
properties.description:
Detects the use of the getsystem Meterpreter command by identifying suspicious
service-based process execution patterns involving cmd.exe and pipe-based command execution.
properties.query:
// Normalised, schema-safe detection for Meterpreter getsystem behaviour
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4688
| extend
    Account = coalesce(
        column_ifexists("SubjectUserName", ""),
        column_ifexists("Account", "")
    ),
    AccountDomain = column_ifexists("SubjectDomainName", ""),
    Computer = column_ifexists("Computer", ""),
    NewProcessName = column_ifexists("NewProcessName", ""),
    NewProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("NewProcessId", "")),
    ParentProcessName = column_ifexists("ParentProcessName", ""),
    CommandLine = column_ifexists("CommandLine", "")
| where CommandLine has_all ("/c", "echo", "pipe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("cmd", "%COMSPEC%")
| where ParentProcessName =~ "services.exe"
| where isnotempty(CommandLine)
| extend AccountFull = iff(
    isempty(AccountDomain),
    Account,
    strcat(AccountDomain, "\\", Account)
)
